name: Auto-archive closed tasks
description: Nightly board hygiene: tasks done or cancelled for more than 30 days are archived. Archiving is terminal and emits NO events (it can never wake other workflows), and each archive re-checks the task is still closed — a task reopened between sweep and archive is left alone. Tune olderThanDays on the sweep step or deactivate the schedule on the workflow's Triggers tab.

en.name: Auto-archive closed tasks
en.description: Nightly hygiene that archives tasks done or cancelled for more than 30 days, skipping any reopened in the meantime.
